name_zh: 马奎斯/蓬巴尔/地震/启蒙：启蒙改革与地震重建
description_zh: 塞巴斯蒂昂·若泽·德·卡瓦略 (1699-1782) 蓬巴尔侯爵/葡萄牙首相 (1750-1777)/1755 里斯本大地震/启蒙/改革/专制/开明/耶稣会/驱逐/教育/军队/经济/贸易/巴西/黄金/马奎斯/蓬巴尔/地震/启蒙/葡萄牙。核心模式：启蒙改革地震重建 — 地震/启蒙/改革/专制/耶稣会/教育/经济/遗产/蓬巴尔/葡萄牙。体现 M246 启蒙改革/地震重建 — 以"地震+启蒙+改革+专制"四位一体，在自然灾害/耶稣会/保守派/帝国四重约束中构建葡萄牙启蒙改革重建范式。
description_en: Sebastiao Jose de Carvalho (1699-1782) Marquis of Pombal/Portugal Prime Minister (1750-1777)/1755 Lisbon earthquake/Enlightenment/reform/absolutism/enlightened/Jesuits/expulsion/education/army/economy/trade/Brazil/gold/Marquis/Pombal/earthquake/Enlightenment/Portugal. Core model: Enlightenment Reform Earthquake Reconstruction — earthquake/Enlightenment/reform/absolutism/Jesuits/education/economy/legacy/Pombal/Portugal. Exemplifies M246 Enlightenment Reform/Earthquake Reconstruction — quaternity of 'earthquake + Enlightenment + reform + absolutism' building Portuguese Enlightenment reform reconstruction paradigm amid quadruple constraints of natural disaster/Jesuits/conservatives/empire.
reason_zh: 蓬巴尔非单纯首相，而是"地震+启蒙+改革"三位一体开明专制改革家。以地震为契机重建里斯本，以启蒙理念驱逐耶稣会，以专制权力推行教育/军队/经济改革。M246 区隔于 M244 重征服(西德)、M247 公司国家(萨拉查)、M245 独裁转型(弗朗哥)，核心在于"地震即改革契机+启蒙即思想武器+专制即执行保障"的葡萄牙启蒙改革范式。
reason_en: Pombal not mere PM but 'earthquake + Enlightenment + reform' trinity enlightened absolutist reformer. Earthquake as opportunity to rebuild Lisbon, Enlightenment ideas expelled Jesuits, absolutist power drove education/army/economic reforms. M246 distinct from M244 Reconquest (El Cid), M247 Corporate State (Salazar), M245 Dictatorship Transition (Franco), core: 'earthquake as reform opportunity + Enlightenment as intellectual weapon + absolutism as execution guarantee' Portuguese Enlightenment reform paradigm.
